tasks.name: Perfection of Crondis
steps: Choose an Expert run with every Zebak invocation active; assign a player to intercept crocodiles.
Finish the water room in under one minute: keep water in every container and stop all crocodiles reaching the tree.
At Zebak, match protection prayers and dodge poison, blood spawns and waves; nobody may be hit by these.
Push at most two jugs across the whole Zebak fight; destroy stationary jugs when possible. Complete both rooms in this run.

tasks.name: Perfect Scabaras
steps: Split the Scabaras puzzles between teammates and agree on the solutions before starting.
Avoid puzzle hazards, including wrong answers and unsafe floor tiles; finish the entire room in under one minute with nobody taking puzzle damage.

tasks.name: Perfect Kephri
steps: Enter Kephri with at least two players; assign someone to destroy every egg before it hatches.
Move away from bomb targets and dung paths; handle exploding scarabs and bodyguards without letting anyone take their damage.
Keep this clean through the final phase: boss attacks, egg explosions and dung must also hit nobody.

tasks.name: Perfection of Scabaras
steps: Use an Expert run with at least two players; divide the Scabaras puzzles so the room finishes in under one minute without puzzle damage.
At Kephri, destroy every egg before hatching and dodge bomb targets and dung paths.
Prevent egg explosions, boss attacks, exploding scarabs, bodyguards and dung from damaging anyone; complete both rooms in this run.

tasks.name: Perfect Wardens
steps: Use at least two players and enable every Wardens invocation before entering.
Match prayers to Warden attacks, dodge obelisk hazards and clear phase-three skulls before they explode.
Keep everyone clear of floor slams, lightning and demi-god attacks through the final phase; one player's avoidable hit fails the attempt.

tasks.name: Insanity
steps: Start an Expert-or-higher run with at least two players and all Wardens invocations active.
Protect against Warden attacks, dodge obelisk hazards and destroy the phase-three skulls in time.
Avoid floor slams, lightning and demi-god attacks throughout the finish; nobody may take avoidable damage.

tasks.name: Amascut's Remnant
steps: Set raid level to at least 500 and agree on safe puzzle roles and invocation mechanics with the whole team.
Keep supplies for the Wardens and prioritise movement and prayer changes over extra attacks.
Finish the entire raid with no deaths from anyone; a teammate's death also fails the task.

tasks.name: Something of an expert myself
steps: Set raid level to at least 350; choose invocations whose mechanics your team can handle consistently.
Save healing and prayer supplies for the Wardens, and stop attacking when a mechanic needs attention.
Finish every room with nobody dying; solo runs also count if you survive throughout.

tasks.name: Maybe I'm the boss.
steps: Enable every boss invocation before the run; practise the added attacks before attempting a deathless clear.
Prepare switches and assign team roles for eggs, puzzle hazards and Wardens skulls.
Complete the full raid without any player dying; skipping one boss invocation invalidates the attempt.

tasks.name: Dropped the ball
steps: Fight Akkha until the message says magical orbs begin to materialise around you.
Stop moving while that effect lasts; movement leaves trailing orbs, so these are not objects to pick up.
Move again after the stop-materialising message, handle Akkha's remaining attacks, and survive the kill yourself.

tasks.name: Akkhan't Do it
steps: Use an Expert raid, enable every Akkha invocation, and raise Akkha's path to level 4 or higher before fighting him.
Attack with the style he is not protecting against; match his attacks with the correct overhead and handle memory sequences carefully.
Dodge the enrage orbs while using melee to finish; you must survive the entire fight yourself.

tasks.name: No skipping allowed
steps: Enable Boulderdash for Ba-Ba and prepare a ranged weapon for the rolling-boulder phase.
Attack only the ordinary, non-weak boulders to make a passage; never shoot the cracked weak boulder.
Pass through your cleared lane, resume the fight and survive Ba-Ba yourself.

tasks.name: I'm in a rush
steps: Plan each rolling-boulder phase around one safe opening and count every boulder you destroy.
Use that opening rather than clearing extra lanes; destroy no more than four boulders across the whole fight.
Finish Ba-Ba and survive personally; the limit is not four per wave.

tasks.name: Ba-Bananza
steps: Start an Expert raid with every Ba-Ba invocation active and Ba-Ba's path at level 4 or higher.
Protect from Melee, step away from slams and falling rocks, and use a cleared lane during rolling boulders.
Keep dung and sarcophagus hazards under control and survive the kill yourself.

tasks.name: All Praise Zebak
steps: Use an Expert run with every Zebak invocation and path level 4 or higher; keep all prayers off.
Dodge waves, poison and blood hazards while preserving enough health to withstand the fight without prayer use.
Kill Zebak without losing a single prayer point and survive yourself; offensive prayers also spend points.

tasks.name: Rockin' around the croc
steps: Use an Expert raid, enable every Zebak invocation and raise his path to level 4 or higher.
Change overheads with his projectiles, avoid poison and waves, and use jug-cleared tiles for the roar.
Keep attacking from safe tiles through the faster final phase and survive the kill yourself.

tasks.name: Doesn't bug me
steps: Use an Expert raid with all Kephri invocations active and Kephri's path at level 4 or higher.
Dodge bomb targets and dung paths; deal with eggs, bodyguards and healing scarabs promptly.
Keep a safe passage open for the final phase and survive Kephri yourself.

tasks.name: All out of medics
steps: Enable Medic in an Expert run; concentrate on Kephri until her first down.
After that down, prioritise healing scarabs before they restore her above 25% health; assign this role in a team.
Maintain the healing cap for the rest of the fight and survive personally.

tasks.name: Down Do Specs
steps: Prepare melee core damage for phase two of a normal-or-higher Wardens fight; save special energy for the core.
Use salts and, if available, liquid adrenaline with dragon dagger specials to make each core exposure count.
Defeat phase two in no more than two staggers, then finish the Wardens without dying yourself.

tasks.name: Better get movin'
steps: Enable Aerial Assault, Stay Vigilant and Insanity, and ensure Elidinis' Warden is the phase-three opponent.
Track changing floor attacks, clear skulls promptly and dodge the larger demi-god hazards.
Defeat Elidinis' Warden in phase three and survive yourself; a different Warden does not meet the condition.

tasks.name: Warden't you believe it
steps: Start an Expert raid with every Wardens invocation enabled and supplies reserved for the finale.
Handle obelisk attacks, core phases and skulls; follow the active floor pattern and demi-god attacks in phase three.
Complete the Wardens encounter without dying personally.

tasks.name: Novice Tomb Explorer
steps: Choose an Entry-or-higher raid with a manageable invocation setup and bring switches for all three combat styles.
Solve all four paths, then complete the Wardens fight; a partial raid is not a completion.

tasks.name: Novice Tomb Looter
steps: Use a repeatable Entry-or-higher setup; carry combat-style switches and learn the four path puzzles.
Finish complete raids until your qualifying completion count reaches 25; individual boss kills do not count as raids.

tasks.name: Novice Tomb Raider
steps: Run Entry-or-higher raids with a setup you can finish reliably rather than adding unfamiliar invocations.
Complete every path and the Wardens each time; work towards 50 qualifying full completions.

tasks.name: Movin' on up
steps: Set the raid invocation level to at least 50 before entering; this is raid level, not your account's combat level.
Bring all three combat styles, solve each path and defeat the Wardens to complete the raid.

tasks.name: Confident Raider
steps: Set raid level to at least 100 using invocations you can handle consistently.
Complete all four paths and the Wardens; changing only your account's combat level will not satisfy the requirement.

tasks.name: Tomb Looter
steps: Choose normal-or-higher raids, at raid level 150 or above, and keep a consistent invocation setup.
Finish all paths and the Wardens until you have 25 qualifying completions; Entry Mode runs do not meet this task.

tasks.name: Tomb Raider
steps: Farm normal-or-higher raids at raid level 150 or above with a reliable three-style setup.
Complete the whole raid 50 times in total; Entry Mode completions do not count towards this target.

tasks.name: Tomb Explorer
steps: Set raid level to at least 150 for a normal-or-higher raid and prepare melee, ranged and magic switches.
Complete all four paths and defeat the Wardens; Entry Mode is below this task's required difficulty.

tasks.name: Expert Tomb Explorer
steps: Set raid level to at least 300 for Expert Mode; choose familiar invocations and keep supplies for the Wardens.
Clear every path and the final encounter once to record an Expert completion.

tasks.name: Expert Tomb Looter
steps: Use Expert raids at raid level 300 or above with a repeatable invocation setup.
Complete every path and the Wardens until your Expert completion count reaches 25; lower-level raids do not count.

tasks.name: Expert Tomb Raider
steps: Run Expert raids at raid level 300 or above and retain a setup you can finish consistently.
Reach 50 full Expert completions; killing the path bosses without finishing the Wardens is not enough.

tasks.name: More than just a ranged weapon
steps: Equip a salamander and bring its matching tar; remove recoil, thralls and other sources of damage.
Use the salamander's attack styles to damage Muspah through the fight, including its prayer-shield phase.
Finish with salamander damage only; swapping to a conventional weapon for the shield fails the restriction.

tasks.name: Can't Escape
steps: Turn run off before engaging and keep it off for the entire kill.
Walk around spikes and lightning, and shelter behind a spike for the large shockwave.
Use controlled walking routes rather than long last-second dodges; kill Muspah without running once.

tasks.name: Essence Farmer
steps: Pack supplies for ten kills and both ranged and magic options before entering.
Kite or freeze the melee form, change protection for its attacks and shelter from the shockwave.
Stay for ten kills in this trip; banking or leaving before the tenth breaks the streak.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare ranged and magic switches and boost before engaging; attempt this off a Slayer task.
Keep damage going between form changes, avoid spikes, and handle the shield with Smite or enchanted sapphire bolts.
Finish the kill in under 3:00; wasted movement during transitions costs time.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Speed-Chaser
steps: Enter off a Slayer task with boosted ranged and magic gear and a plan for the shield phase.
Attack continuously between safe movements; use Smite or enchanted sapphire bolts to shorten the prayer shield.
Finish in under 2:00 while avoiding spikes that heal Muspah.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Speed-Runner
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task; prepare damage boosts, accurate switches and a fast prayer-shield method before engaging.
Avoid lost attacks on form changes and clear the shield using Smite or enchanted sapphire bolts.
Finish in under 1:30; leave spikes clear so Muspah receives no unnecessary healing.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Adept
steps: Bring ranged and magic options and start the fight with protection prayers ready.
Kite the melee form, dodge newly appearing spikes and lightning, and shelter behind a spike for the shockwave.
Drain the prayer shield with Smite or enchanted sapphire bolts, then finish one kill.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Veteran
steps: Use ranged and magic switches; dodge spikes and shelter from the large shockwave.
Handle the shield with Smite or enchanted sapphire bolts and repeat successful kills until your total reaches 25.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Master
steps: Farm Muspah using reliable form switches and a prayer-shield method such as enchanted sapphire bolts.
Keep spikes and lightning out of your route and build to 50 total kills; these need not be in one trip.

tasks.name: Space is Tight
steps: Leave Muspah alive at low health while you arrange the final position.
Choose a reachable tile enclosed by the existing spikes, without stepping onto spikes yourself.
Deliver the finishing damage while surrounded; killing first and moving into position afterwards does not count.

tasks.name: Versatile Drainer
steps: Bring enchanted sapphire bolts, Smite and runes for Lesser or Greater Corruption on the Arceuus spellbook.
At the prayer shield, apply corruption and let its drain occur before the shield is removed.
Also drain with Smite and a sapphire-bolt effect during this kill; three drains from one source are not three different sources.

tasks.name: Walk Straight Pray True
steps: Use the correct protection for Muspah's attacks and move when spikes begin forming under your position.
Avoid lightning and homing spikes; shelter behind an existing spike for the large shockwave.
Finish without any avoidable damage; do not stand on spikes to take a shortcut.

tasks.name: Phantom Muspah Manipulator
steps: Keep run disabled from the start and use correct prayers while walking clear of spikes and lightning.
Shelter from the shockwave, and stop damage at low health to prepare a tile surrounded by spikes.
Finish from that enclosed position without any avoidable damage or running during the whole fight.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Speed-Trialist
steps: Boost before engaging and prepare strong melee damage; attempt the timer off a Slayer task.
Keep Protect from Melee ready, dodge axes and react to the head's prayer attack without dropping unnecessary attacks.
Finish in under 1:15; pre-plan blood-splat movement to preserve attacking time.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Speed-Chaser
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task with boosted melee gear and special attacks ready.
Maintain safe attacks while dodging axes, handling the head and clearing blood-splat prompts.
Finish in under 1:05; panic movement away from melee range wastes valuable time.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Speed-Runner
steps: Use your strongest reliable melee setup, pre-boost and attempt off a Slayer task.
Keep attacking between axe dodges and react immediately to the head and blood-splat prompts.
Finish in under 0:55; save movement for real hazards rather than leaving attack range unnecessarily.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Adept
steps: Bring melee gear and protection prayers; stay ready to dodge axes and clear blood-splat prompts.
React to the head's ranged attack, restore your melee protection and finish Vardorvis once.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Master
steps: Use a melee setup you can sustain; handle axes, the head and blood-splat prompts on each kill.
Build to 50 total Vardorvis kills; these are cumulative, so bank whenever supplies need replenishing.

tasks.name: Vardorvis Sleeper
steps: Bring an awakener's orb and select the Awakened Vardorvis encounter.
Track the added attack pressure, keep prayer changes deliberate and prioritise axe dodges over extra hits.
Finish the Awakened fight; an ordinary Vardorvis kill does not meet this task.

tasks.name: Perfect Vardorvis
steps: Stock supplies for five kills and keep protection prayers ready before starting the streak.
Dodge every axe, handle the head and blood-splat mechanics, and avoid melee hits without protection.
Complete five perfect kills consecutively without leaving; a mistake requires a fresh five-kill streak.

tasks.name: Axe Enthusiast
steps: Reduce Vardorvis to his maximum attack speed, then stop damaging him.
Stay inside the central 5-by-5 area for at least three minutes at that speed while handling axes, the head and blood splats.
Only resume damage after the full survival period, then finish the kill; time before maximum speed does not count.

tasks.name: Budget Cutter
steps: Check the total current value of every equipped item before fighting; keep the setup at or below 2 million coins.
Include special-attack and other gear switches in that budget, rather than checking only your main weapon.
Handle axes, prayer changes and blood splats and finish the kill with the restricted setup.

tasks.name: Whisperer Speed-Trialist
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task with a boosted magic setup and your blackstone fragment ready.
Keep casting between tentacle dodges; handle shadow-realm patterns, spirits and pillars without long delays.
Use the final phase's safe movement pattern and finish in under 3:00.

tasks.name: Whisperer Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare boosted magic damage and attempt off a Slayer task; keep the blackstone fragment accessible.
Switch promptly for shadow mechanics, solve spirits and pillars, and preserve casting time while dodging tentacles.
Finish in under 2:25, including the enrage phase.

tasks.name: Whisperer Speed-Runner
steps: Use your strongest reliable magic setup and pre-boost for an off-task attempt.
Resolve the shadow mechanics quickly and attack between tentacle dodges rather than running without a plan.
Finish in under 2:05; keep damage going during the enrage movement pattern.

tasks.name: Whisperer Adept
steps: Bring magic gear and the blackstone fragment; watch the attack sequence and dodge tentacles.
Use the fragment for shadow-realm mechanics and solve the spirit and pillar phases.
Keep moving safely through enrage and complete one Whisperer kill.

tasks.name: Whisperer Master
steps: Use a sustainable magic setup and keep the fragment available for each shadow-realm mechanic.
Dodge tentacles, solve spirits and pillars, and build to 50 total kills; banking between kills is allowed.

tasks.name: Whispered
steps: Bring an awakener's orb and choose the Awakened Whisperer encounter.
Prepare for the altered attack sequence and shadow-realm patterns; avoid wasting sanity on unnecessary realm time.
Survive the final enrage phase and finish the Awakened fight, rather than the normal version.

tasks.name: Perfect Whisperer
steps: Bring supplies for five kills and keep prayer switches and the blackstone fragment accessible.
Dodge tentacles, match protection prayers, and complete spirits and pillar mechanics without avoidable damage.
Finish five perfect kills consecutively without leaving; start the streak again if a mechanic hits you.

tasks.name: Tentacular
steps: Select the Arceuus spellbook before entering and remain on it throughout the kill.
Use a powered magic staff for sustained damage; plan the fight without Ancient spellbook freezes.
Handle shadow mechanics and enrage, then finish without switching spellbooks.

tasks.name: Dark Memories
steps: Before enrage, enter the shadow realm only briefly to inspect the required patterns, then leave promptly.
Act on the patterns you observed instead of waiting in the realm for the whole mechanic.
Keep your combined pre-enrage realm time below six seconds; several short visits still add together.

tasks.name: Leviathan Speed-Trialist
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task with boosted ranged damage and Shadow spells ready for stuns.
Match prayers to projectiles, stun when needed and exploit the exposed rear while dodging special attacks.
Finish in under 1:50, including the final phase.

tasks.name: Leviathan Speed-Chaser
steps: Pre-boost ranged damage and attempt off a Slayer task with your stun spell accessible.
Keep attacking between prayer changes and use stun openings without wasting movement.
Dodge final-phase hazards and finish in under 1:25.

tasks.name: Leviathan Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare your best ranged damage, pre-boost and attempt off a Slayer task.
Maintain attacks while matching the projectile prayers; make every stun opening count.
Move with the final phase's safe area while attacking and finish in under 1:10.

tasks.name: Leviathan Adept
steps: Bring ranged gear and a Shadow spell for stunning Leviathan.
Change protection with the incoming projectiles, use a stun to manage rising attack pressure and attack the exposed rear.
Dodge its special attacks and finish one kill, keeping up with the final phase's safe area.

tasks.name: Leviathan Master
steps: Use a repeatable ranged setup with a stun spell available; match projectile prayers and exploit stun openings.
Survive the final phase's moving safe area and work towards 50 total kills; the kills need not be consecutive.

tasks.name: Leviathan Sleeper
steps: Bring an awakener's orb and select the Awakened Leviathan fight.
Track the intensified projectile sequence, use stuns deliberately and stay clear of special-attack hazards.
Follow the final phase's safe area and finish the Awakened encounter; normal kills do not count.

tasks.name: Perfect Leviathan
steps: Stock supplies for five kills and prepare ranged attacks plus a stun spell.
Match all projectile prayers and dodge lightning, rocks and final-phase hazards without avoidable damage.
Complete five perfect kills in a row without leaving; rebuild the streak after a mistake.

tasks.name: Serpentine Solo
steps: Prepare ranged damage and decide when to use your single allowed stun before starting.
Handle faster projectile sequences with prayer changes instead of repeatedly casting Shadow spells.
Finish Leviathan with no more than one stun across the whole fight; an early extra stun cannot be undone.

tasks.name: Unconventional
steps: Equip a ranged weapon with mithril ammunition only, remove passive damage sources and start at 25 health or below.
Keep your health at or below 25 for the entire fight; check how much food heals before eating.
Match prayers and dodge specials, then finish using only mithril-ammunition damage.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Speed-Trialist
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task. Prepare both poisons, then boost and equip your melee setup before applying the final poison.
The timer starts when Duke wakes. Use strong slash attacks and useful Defence-lowering specials while stepping safely between his attacks.
Shelter behind a pillar for the gaze and finish combat in under 1:00; preparation is outside this timer.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Speed-Chaser
steps: Attempt off a Slayer task and prepare both poisons. Boost and arrange your melee switches before waking Duke with the final poison.
Attack promptly when he wakes, use Defence-lowering specials if available and preserve attacks while moving around his hazards.
Finish combat in under 0:50. The timer begins on waking, so use the preparation phase to get ready.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare poisons and your strongest reliable slash setup off a Slayer task; boost before applying the final poison.
Make each combat attack count, using useful specials and matching your movement to his faster final phase.
Avoid the gaze behind pillars and finish in under 0:40 from waking Duke; gathering and brewing are outside the combat timer.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Adept
steps: Gather the required ingredients and prepare the potions to wake Duke.
Use melee, keep protection ready and shelter behind the pillars when his gaze begins.
Dodge ground hazards and finish one kill.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Master
steps: Use a melee setup and supplies suitable for repeated ingredient preparation and fights.
Wake Duke with the prepared potions, shelter from his gaze and dodge ground hazards; work towards 50 total kills.

tasks.name: Duke Sucellus Sleeper
steps: Bring an awakener's orb and choose the Awakened Duke encounter.
Prepare the waking potions and handle the added gaze and ground hazards before committing to attacks.
Finish the Awakened fight; ordinary Duke kills do not count for this task.

tasks.name: Perfect Duke Sucellus
steps: Bring enough supplies for five kills and learn a safe route for gathering and preparation.
During combat, shelter from the gaze and dodge falling or ground hazards without avoidable damage.
Complete five perfect kills consecutively without leaving; repeat the full streak if you make a mistake.

tasks.name: Cold Feet
steps: Disable run before starting and leave it disabled through preparation and the fight.
Walk to pillar cover in time for the gaze and step clear of ground hazards before they hit.
Finish Duke with no avoidable damage and without running at any point.

tasks.name: Mirror Image
steps: Turn auto-retaliate off and manually time every attack for the moment Duke attacks.
Follow his animation rather than a fixed interval: his attack timing changes as the fight progresses.
Finish the kill with every attack on the same game tick as Duke's; do not attack freely during idle gaps.

tasks.name: Scurrius Novice
steps: Enter Scurrius with a weapon, healing supplies and protection prayers ready.
Step away from falling bricks and change prayers for his ranged and magic attacks.
Kill Scurrius once; the first successful kill is enough for this task.

tasks.name: Scurrius Champion
steps: Use a sustainable setup and dodge falling bricks while matching prayers to his ranged and magic attacks.
Repeat successful kills until your total reaches ten; the kills do not need to be in one visit.

tasks.name: Sit Rat
steps: Create or bring a ratbane weapon and enter Scurrius's private instance.
Fight normally while dodging bricks and switching prayers; reduce Scurrius to low health.
Use the ratbane weapon for the killing blow; a public-room finish does not qualify.

tasks.name: Perfect Scurrius
steps: Choose a private instance and keep protection prayers ready for each ranged and magic attack.
Move clear of falling bricks and avoid the tail swipe rather than relying on food to recover.
Finish Scurrius without any of those mistakes; protection must match the flying-fur and electric attacks.

tasks.name: Efficient Pest Control
steps: Use a ratbane weapon and wait until at least six giant rats are available together.
Click each rat in rapid succession; ratbane attacks on giant rats let you clear them without the usual delay.
Kill six within three seconds, rather than slowly clearing each new spawn separately.

tasks.name: The Clone Zone
steps: Enter Eclipse Moon and stop attacking it during its ordinary phase.
During the clone phase, turn towards each clone and attack the clones as they appear.
Repeat clone phases until the boss dies; any direct attack on Eclipse Moon outside the clones breaks the task.

tasks.name: High Hitter
steps: Choose one Moon and boost before the fight; use its weak melee style: stab for Eclipse, crush for Blue, slash for Blood.
Keep attacking while following the safe tiles and resolve its first special quickly.
Kill that Moon before its second special begins; finishing during the second special is too late.

tasks.name: Lunar Triplet
steps: Start a fresh reward cycle and kill Eclipse, Blue and Blood Moon before opening the chest.
Use stab against Eclipse, crush against Blue and slash against Blood, while following each fight's safe tiles.
Open the reward chest after all three are defeated; looting partway through separates the cycle.

tasks.name: Perilous Novice
steps: Gather dungeon food and potions, then defeat at least one Moon to unlock a reward chest.
Open the chest and repeat qualifying reward cycles until you have opened it five times; boss kills alone do not advance this target.

tasks.name: Perilous Champion
steps: Prepare supplies inside Neypotzli and defeat one or more Moons each cycle.
Loot the reward chest after each cycle and work towards 25 chest openings; three bosses in one cycle still produce one opening.

tasks.name: Perilous Dancer
steps: Fight Eclipse, Blue and Blood Moon in one reward cycle, following the safe tiles during ordinary attacks.
Avoid every special-attack hazard in all three fights; regular-attack damage is allowed.
Finish the cycle without a special hitting you, rather than healing through its damage.

tasks.name: Fortified
steps: Wear strong defensive armour and choose a Moon whose special mechanics you can avoid confidently.
Boost and eat before engaging; once the fight starts, do not consume food, potions or other consumables.
Follow safe tiles and complete the kill using your starting health and preparation.

tasks.name: Betrayal
steps: Use a Moon's own associated weapon against that Moon; dual macuahuitl against Blood Moon is one option.
Keep using that weapon through the whole fight and move onto safe tiles between attacks.
Finish the matching Moon with its associated weapon, rather than borrowing another Moon's drop.

tasks.name: Back to Our Roots
steps: Bring a dragon scimitar as your only attacking weapon; remove thralls, recoil and other damage sources.
Kill Eclipse, Blue and Blood Moon in one reward cycle, keeping the scimitar equipped for every attack.
Follow each special safely; a faster weapon switch during any of the three fights fails the restriction.

tasks.name: Moons of Peril Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare dungeon supplies and melee switches before beginning the three-Moon cycle.
Use stab for Eclipse, crush for Blue and slash for Blood; maintain damage while following safe tiles.
Defeat all three in one run within eight minutes, minimising travel and preparation delays between fights.

tasks.name: Moons of Peril Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare your route, supplies and melee-style switches before starting.
Keep attacking on safe tiles, solve specials quickly and move directly between the three Moons.
Finish all three in one run within six minutes; unnecessary resupplying consumes the shared timer.

tasks.name: Fat of the Land
steps: Prepare defensive melee gear and collect food and potions inside Neypotzli.
Use the dungeon's resources to replenish supplies between fights without going outside.
Accumulate 30 Moon kills while staying in the dungeon; this is a boss-kill target, not 30 reward chests.

tasks.name: Sportsmanship
steps: Clear Colosseum waves 1-11 with supplies reserved for the final duel.
Against Sol, watch his weapon telegraphs, move clear of spear and shield attacks and respond to grapples.
Finish Sol Heredit once to complete the Colosseum.

tasks.name: Colosseum Grand Champion
steps: Build a repeatable Colosseum setup and save supplies through the earlier waves.
Handle Sol's weapon attacks and grapples safely, then finish the duel.
Complete ten Sol kills in total; each requires reaching and defeating the final wave.

tasks.name: I Brought Mine Too
steps: Clear the earlier Colosseum waves with your usual weapons, then switch before fighting Sol.
Damage Sol only with a spear, hasta or halberd; keep any special attacks within those weapon types.
Finish the duel without other weapon damage or passive damage sources.

tasks.name: Slow Dancing in the Sand
steps: Use normal movement for the earlier waves, then disable run before Sol's fight begins.
Walk out of spear and shield patterns early and handle grapples without relying on a last-second run.
Finish Sol without running during his duel; the restriction is specific to his fight.

tasks.name: Furball
steps: Reach wave four and watch the Manticore's charged attack order before its volley.
Switch protection prayers in that displayed order; the ranged and magic positions can differ.
Finish the wave without taking avoidable Manticore damage; do not assume every volley has one fixed order.

tasks.name: Perfect Footwork
steps: Reach Sol and watch his spear and shield telegraphs so you can step outside their hit areas.
Respond to each grapple by removing the called equipment, and time protection for the triple attack.
Finish with no spear, shield, grapple or triple-attack hits; surviving their damage is not enough.

tasks.name: Showboating
steps: Unlock the Fortis Salute emote and reach Sol with room to move around the arena.
Bring him below 10% health, then stop damaging him so he survives your emotes.
Perform the salute in the north, east, south and west sections of the arena before finishing; merely facing four directions is insufficient.

tasks.name: Denied
steps: Reach wave seven and prioritise the Minotaur before it can heal the remaining enemies.
Use safe positioning and sustained damage to stop its healing opportunity rather than splitting damage across targets.
Finish the wave without the Minotaur healing another enemy.

tasks.name: One-off
steps: Choose a modifier route that gives Red Flag, Dynamic Duo or Doom II by wave eleven.
Prepare your wave-eleven positioning around the selected modifier's added danger.
Complete wave eleven with at least one of those modifiers active; a lower Doom rank is insufficient.

tasks.name: Reinforcements
steps: Plan modifier choices so Bees II, Quartet and Solarflare II are all active for the final duel.
Reach Sol while preserving supplies, then keep the added hazards clear of your movement route.
Defeat Sol with all three required modifiers active together; having only one or two does not count.

tasks.name: I was here first!
steps: Bring a claw-type weapon with special energy and reach a Jaguar Warrior in the Colosseum.
Lower its health without accidentally killing it, then use the claw special for the finishing damage.
Make sure the special kills the warrior; a normal claw attack is not enough.

tasks.name: Colosseum Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare boosts and a practised wave route before entering the Colosseum.
Use pillars to control threats, clear waves promptly and avoid prolonged pauses between waves.
Finish Sol with the full completion timer at 28:00 or less; a fast Sol duel alone is insufficient.

tasks.name: Colosseum Speed-Runner
steps: Use a practised full-run setup with boosts and special attacks planned for key waves.
Resolve each wave efficiently, preserve enough supplies for Sol and keep transitions short.
Complete the entire Colosseum in 24:00 or less, including the final duel.

tasks.name: Unending Torment
steps: Fight a Tormented Demon in the Ancient Guthixian Temple with at least two attacking styles ready.
Switch away from the style its overhead protects against, match its attacks with your prayers and dodge the fire bombs.
Finish one demon; keep attacking after its shield drops for a useful damage opening.

tasks.name: Through Fire and Flames
steps: Lower a Tormented Demon to finishing range, then stop ordinary damage.
Wait for its fire shield to drop after a bomb attack, and use that opening for the killing blow.
Finish while the shield is inactive; damaging it earlier during a shield-down window is not sufficient.

tasks.name: Two Times the Torment
steps: Choose an area that allows two demons and bring both to low health without killing either.
Keep them engaged and dodge bombs while preparing two fast finishing hits or overlapping projectiles.
Kill both within two seconds of each other; accidental early damage can spoil the setup.

tasks.name: Three Times the Thrashing
steps: Use a triple-demon area and lower all three to finishing range while keeping them in combat.
Remove uncontrolled passive damage and arrange rapid finishes or overlapping projectiles before committing.
Kill all three within three seconds; the window starts with the first death.

tasks.name: Rapid Reload
steps: Bring a Hunters' sunlight crossbow and use a triple-demon area; its fast attacks are a simple option for this task.
Shoot each of the three demons in succession so all three hits occur within three seconds; kills are unnecessary.
With another crossbow or ballista, engage all three first and use their shield-down openings for accelerated attacks.

tasks.name: Araxxor Veteran
steps: Bring crush melee damage and a ranged option for araxytes on an eligible Slayer assignment.
Handle eggs and minions promptly, move clear of acid and dodge the enrage cleaves.
Work towards 25 total Araxxor kills; you can bank between trips.

tasks.name: Araxxor Master
steps: Use a reliable crush setup with supplies for venom and a quick araxyte switch.
Keep acid out of your movement route, resolve minions and dodge enrage cleaves.
Build to 75 total kills; this target does not require a single uninterrupted trip.

tasks.name: Araxxor Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare boosted crush damage and supplies for four kills before starting the timed streak.
Clear dangerous araxytes quickly and keep attacking while dodging acid and enrage cleaves.
Complete four Araxxor kills within ten minutes; reduce looting and other delays between spawns.

tasks.name: Araxxor Speed-Chaser
steps: Enter with boosts, a reliable crush weapon and supplies ready for five kills.
Resolve minions quickly, avoid acid detours and maintain attacks between enrage dodges.
Kill Araxxor five times within ten minutes; leaving to resupply wastes the attempt's time.

tasks.name: Araxxor Speed-Runner
steps: Plan a sustained crush setup and supplies for six kills, with special attacks saved for useful damage openings.
Deal with araxytes quickly and avoid losing attack time to acid or enrage cleaves.
Finish six kills within ten minutes; eggs are not healing targets and do not need clearing for every speed attempt.

tasks.name: Perfect Araxxor
steps: Keep the appropriate overhead active; promptly kill acidic araxytes or destroy their green eggs before hatching.
Avoid acid pools and acid-ball paths, red araxyte explosions and reflected damage from mirrorbacks.
Dodge every enrage cleave and finish without avoidable damage; an off-prayer zero from a minion can still fail the task.

tasks.name: Perfect Araxxor 2
steps: Prepare a perfect fight with no thralls, recoil or lingering damage that could hit during enrage.
Protect correctly and avoid acid, minions and reflected damage until Araxxor enrages, then stop all attacks.
Step under him to bait a cleave onto his own tiles, then step clear when he shouts; repeat the self-damage method until he dies without hitting him yourself.

tasks.name: Let it seep in
steps: Let any existing poison or venom immunity expire before engaging; do not wear a serpentine helm.
Avoid antipoison and anti-venom doses throughout the fight, and keep acid pools out of your route.
Finish Araxxor without ever gaining either immunity; surviving the venom does not permit an immunity dose midway.

tasks.name: Relaxxor
steps: Keep Araxxor alive while you destroy six eggs and count each destroyed egg.
Avoid acid and handle any remaining araxytes while clearing the eggs; hatched minions are not destroyed eggs.
Only finish the boss after the sixth egg is destroyed.

tasks.name: Swimming in Venom
steps: Start in melee range and choose your position so Araxxor does not need to walk towards you.
Dodge acid and cleaves with short steps that keep you within melee reach; avoid luring him across the room.
Finish without the boss moving once; player movement is allowed if Araxxor stays in place.

tasks.name: Araxyte Betrayal
steps: Keep three araxytes alive and bring them close to a red exploding araxyte.
Lower their health if needed, then stop damaging them so the red araxyte's explosion delivers the kills.
Have that one araxyte kill all three others; killing them yourself or splitting the kills between explosions does not count.

tasks.name: Arachnid Lover
steps: Pack healing, prayer and venom supplies for ten Araxxor kills before entering.
Resolve minions, keep a clear acid route and dodge enrage cleaves on each spawn.
Stay for ten kills without leaving; a bank trip before the tenth ends the streak.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Champion
steps: Join the Hueycoatl fight with melee gear and a crush option for its tail.
Match prayer to the coloured projectiles and step across the tail-slam waves rather than standing in them.
Finish one qualifying Hueycoatl kill.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Adept
steps: Use a reliable Hueycoatl setup, respond to projectile colours and avoid tail-slam waves.
Help break the tail and maintain damage during safe openings; accumulate ten total kills.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Veteran
steps: Farm Hueycoatl with the correct projectile prayers and a plan for dodging tail-slam waves.
Attack the tail and body in their active phases and work towards 25 total kills; one long trip is unnecessary.

tasks.name: Perfect Hueycoatl
steps: Bring supplies for five kills and keep the projectile prayer changes deliberate.
Avoid lightning, tail-slam waves and any projectile hit without the right protection.
Complete five perfect kills consecutively without leaving; a mistake breaks the clean streak.

tasks.name: Pillar Lover
steps: Coordinate the prayer pillars with your group so Hueycoatl's vulnerability is active.
Hold finishing damage if needed until the pillars create the vulnerable state.
Deliver the killing blow while it is vulnerable; activating the pillars earlier in the fight is not enough.

tasks.name: Is it a bird?
steps: Equip only dragonbane weapons for damage and remove thralls, recoil and other damage sources.
Use qualifying weapon attacks throughout the tail and body phases, while handling projectile prayers and slam waves.
Finish without switching to an ordinary weapon for a quicker phase.

tasks.name: You're a wizard
steps: Bring runes and a spellbook that can cast earth spells; remove other sources of damage.
Damage the tail and body using earth spells only, while matching projectile prayers and avoiding slam waves.
Finish without powered-staff attacks or other elemental spells; magic damage alone is not the restriction.

tasks.name: I'm your son
steps: Equip two pieces of Hueycoatl armour before engaging and retain both through the fight.
Match protection prayers, dodge slam waves and help damage the active tail and body.
Finish with the required armour worn; simply carrying two pieces in your inventory does not count.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare boosts and coordinate fast damage on the tail before the attempt.
Maintain body damage while handling projectile prayers and tail-slam waves safely.
Complete the Hueycoatl kill within 2:30; avoid long pauses when the active target changes.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Chaser
steps: Start with no more than five players and arrange the group's tail and body damage before engaging.
Keep prayer changes and slam dodges quick so the team maintains damage.
Finish within 2:30 with the group-size restriction met; adding extra helpers invalidates this version.

tasks.name: Hueycoatl Speed-Runner
steps: Limit the attempt to no more than three players and coordinate boosts and tail damage.
Keep damage going through target changes while matching projectile prayers and dodging slams.
Finish within 2:30; a larger group cannot earn this version of the speed task.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Champion
steps: Bring melee gear and Protect from Magic; attack Amoxliatl while leaving newly formed icy pools.
Reactivate magic protection when she disables prayers, and destroy unstable ice before it explodes.
Finish one kill while keeping your route clear of icy tiles.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Adept
steps: Use a sustainable melee setup, protect from magic and move off each newly formed icy pool.
Destroy unstable ice and restore protection after prayer-disabling attacks; build to 20 total kills.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Speed-Trialist
steps: Boost before engaging and use a quick melee setup to maintain damage between ice attacks.
Move onto clean tiles and destroy unstable ice promptly so it cannot heal the boss.
Finish Amoxliatl in under one minute.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare boosts and burst melee damage before the fight; keep the opening attack sequence efficient.
Continue attacking from clean tiles and prevent unstable ice from exploding and restoring health.
Finish in under 30 seconds; unnecessary target changes or lost attacks can spoil the timer.

tasks.name: Nagua Negation
steps: Keep Protect from Magic active, including immediately after prayer-disabling attacks.
Move away from the tile where each icy pool forms and destroy unstable ice before it explodes.
Finish with no damage at all; avoiding specials while taking an ordinary hit is still a failure.

tasks.name: Temotli Triumph
steps: Equip glacial temotli as your only attacking weapon and remove passive damage sources.
Protect from magic, leave icy pools and destroy unstable ice using the permitted weapon.
Finish Amoxliatl without another weapon switch; a different temotli or ordinary melee weapon does not qualify.

tasks.name: Without Ralos' Light
steps: Keep all prayers off before and throughout the encounter, including offensive prayers.
Dodge the icicle that can drain prayer points and keep clear of icy pools; bring enough healing for unprotected ordinary attacks.
Finish without losing any prayer points; merely avoiding prayer use is insufficient if an attack drains them.

tasks.name: Kemo Makti
steps: Bring supplies for ten kills before entering Amoxliatl's chamber.
Move off icy pools, restore magic protection after it is disabled and destroy unstable ice on each kill.
Remain in the chamber until the tenth kill; leaving to bank breaks the streak.

tasks.name: Totally Shattered
steps: Keep attacking Amoxliatl from clean tiles until unstable ice appears.
Switch immediately to destroy every unstable ice block before it explodes; dodging its explosion alone does not satisfy this task.
Resume boss damage and repeat until she dies with no unstable ice having shattered.

tasks.name: Perfect Royal Titans
steps: Use positioning that avoids both Titans' melee attacks rather than tanking them with prayers.
Keep clear of elemental explosions, icicle and fire spawns, and the pulse attack throughout the fight.
Finish the Titans without any avoidable damage; coordinate both players' movement if fighting as a duo.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Champion
steps: Bring a melee setup and elemental spell options to deal with the fight's hazards.
Avoid melee attacks and ground hazards, damage each Titan in its vulnerable phases and build to ten total completed kills.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Adept
steps: Use a repeatable setup with melee damage and spells for ice and fire hazards.
Handle the elemental spawns and finish both Titans on each attempt; accumulate 25 completed kills in total.

tasks.name: One by one
steps: Choose which Titan to kill first and keep all damage on that target until it dies.
Avoid area attacks, thralls or a teammate's hits reaching the other Titan early.
Only begin damaging the second Titan after the first is dead, then finish the encounter.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Speed-Runner
steps: Boost and prepare melee damage and elemental spells before starting.
Clear hazards promptly and maintain attacks while the Titans are vulnerable; keep target changes deliberate.
Finish both Titans in under 1:30; a quick first Titan alone does not meet the timer.

tasks.name: Titan Killer
steps: Enter one instance with your intended team and supplies for 15 encounters.
Keep that same instance occupied for all 15 kills; do not add players midway or leave to resupply.
Any join resets the progress and leaving breaks the attempt, so complete the full sequence together.

tasks.name: Elemental Company
steps: Keep all attacks on the Titans and never click an elemental to attack it.
Avoid area attacks and uncontrolled damage that could strike elementals; dodge their hazards instead.
Finish both Titans with no elemental attacked during the encounter.

tasks.name: I need room
steps: Bring water spells for fires and fire spells for icicles before entering.
Prioritise each new hazard immediately and clear every fire and icicle before it naturally disappears.
Finish both Titans without letting even one timed hazard expire uncleared.

tasks.name: No time to pray
steps: Disable all prayers before the fight and keep them off, including offensive prayers.
Avoid melee and ground hazards by moving, and bring enough food for the unprotected encounter.
Finish both Titans without losing any prayer points.

tasks.name: Let them fight
steps: Keep the Titans alive while elemental spawns accumulate; do not kill the elementals yourself.
Position elementals where the Titans' attacks can kill them, while staying clear of those attacks yourself.
Count ten elemental deaths caused by the Titans before finishing both bosses.

tasks.name: It takes too long
steps: Damage both Titans down to finishing range without killing either during an earlier phase.
Keep them alive until a charging phase offers a shared finishing window, and coordinate the two kills if in a duo.
Kill both during that same charging phase; finishing the second in a later phase does not count.

tasks.name: Yama Adept
steps: Bring your combat switches and supplies, with a plan for dodging shadow and fire hazards.
Attack the judge with the correct style when exiled, then return to the arena promptly.
Finish Yama once, keeping enough supplies for the final attack pressure.

tasks.name: Yama Veteran
steps: Use a reliable Yama setup and practise shadow positioning, fire dodges and the exile return.
Switch to the correct style for the judge and finish the fight; accumulate 50 total kills rather than staying for all 50 in one trip.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Trialist
steps: Prepare boosts and consistent damage for four Yama kills, including quick judge-style switches.
Keep movement and exile returns efficient while avoiding unnecessary pauses in damage.
Make the average of your last four kills under 3:38; one fast kill cannot offset an unfinished four-kill sample.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Chaser
steps: Plan four efficient kills with boosts, damage switches and judge attacks ready.
Keep attacking between safe hazard dodges and return from each exile quickly.
Bring the average time of your last four kills below 3:00; aim for four consistent times rather than one lucky attempt.

tasks.name: Yama Speed-Runner
steps: Use a practised setup and plan your damage, exile switches and final-phase movement across four kills.
Minimise lost attacks without taking reckless shadow or fire hits that force extra healing.
Finish with a last-four-kill average below 2:34; the individual boss timer is only one part of that average.

tasks.name: No toppings, no drinks, thanks
steps: Have everyone bring plain pizzas as their only healing and leave all potions out of the attempt.
Remove healing effects such as blood spells or a blood fury; no player may use a different healing source.
Handle Yama's mechanics and finish with the whole team obeying both restrictions throughout.

tasks.name: Shadow dancer
steps: For each shadow crash, stay within one tile of its centre rather than running far across the arena.
Dodge the shadow impact using the nearby safe position and repeat for every crash.
Finish Yama without a shadow hit or leaving that allowed distance during a crash.

tasks.name: Fire fighter
steps: Dodge every fire hazard and reserve special-attack energy for void flares.
Damage and kill each void flare using special attacks only; do not slip in ordinary attacks while energy is low.
Finish Yama without any fire hit, maintaining the flare restriction throughout.

tasks.name: Back so soon?
steps: On each exile, inspect the judge's protection and use a style it is not protecting against.
Avoid repeated damage while returning: each separate exile allows at most one damage instance.
Finish Yama with no wrong-style judge attack and no exile exceeding that limit.

tasks.name: Contract Choreographer
steps: Stay within one tile of each shadow crash's centre while dodging its impact; never take a shadow or fire hit.
Use only special attacks to kill void flares and attack the judge with the correct style.
Take at most one damage instance per exile and avoid all other avoidable damage while finishing Yama.

tasks.name: Contractually Unbound
steps: Take a non-standard contract and prepare your setup for its elevated conditions before engaging.
Keep the contract's extra restrictions active through Yama's arena and exile phases, rather than satisfying only its ordinary completion.
Finish Yama with the elevated conditions completed for that contract.

tasks.name: Doom Adept
steps: Enter the delve with supplies and combat switches for consecutive encounters.
Kill grubs before absorption and handle the boss's charge and acid hazards as you progress.
Reach delve level three and defeat Doom there; a level-one kill alone does not count.

tasks.name: Doom Veteran
steps: Prepare enough supplies and switches to continue through the delve sequence.
Prioritise grubs and maintain a clear route around acid while resolving charge attacks.
Defeat Doom at delve level eight; stop only after that level's kill is complete.

tasks.name: It's Dark Down Here
steps: Pack a sustained delve setup and conserve supplies through the earlier levels.
Handle grubs, acid and charge mechanics reliably rather than trading health for unnecessary attacks.
Continue to level sixteen and defeat Doom there; reaching the level without its kill is insufficient.

tasks.name: Exposed Doom
steps: Bring Doom to finishing range, then stop damage until its melee charge begins.
Keep your melee finishing attack ready and land it during that charge window.
Kill Doom before the phase ends; merely interrupting the charge earlier in the fight does not meet the task.

tasks.name: Mokhaiotl Drift
steps: Attempt at delve level eight or higher with boosts and burst damage ready.
Maintain damage from the opening and resolve hazards without long pauses.
Kill Doom before its first burrow finishes; a fast later burrow is not a replacement for that opening window.

tasks.name: Grub Patrol
steps: Commit to clearing delve levels one through eight and make grubs your immediate priority each time.
Intercept and kill every grub before it reaches absorption, even if this costs boss damage.
Finish level eight with no grub absorbed anywhere in the sequence; one missed grub spoils all eight levels.

tasks.name: Perfect Doom
steps: Prepare a safe route and grub response before starting the eight-level sequence.
Avoid all boss damage and every acid tile, while killing grubs before they are absorbed.
Complete levels one through eight cleanly; correcting a mistake on a later level does not restore the attempt.

tasks.name: The Praying Mantis
steps: Start with full prayer and a setup designed to conserve it through eight levels.
Use no prayer restoration from potions, equipment effects, special attacks or other sources; turn prayers off between needed uses.
Defeat Doom on every level from one through eight without restoring a prayer point anywhere in the sequence.

tasks.name: Duel of Mokhaiotl
steps: Choose a one-handed melee weapon for all boss damage across levels one through eight.
Remove thralls, recoil and other non-qualifying boss damage; do not use a two-handed special weapon midway.
Complete the eight levels with only one-handed melee damage dealt to Doom.

tasks.name: Darkness Is Your Ally?
steps: Remove all demonbane equipment before beginning and leave it out of every switch.
Use ordinary weapons through levels one to eight, including grub-handling and special-attack switches.
Finish the sequence without equipping a demonbane weapon even briefly; simply avoiding its attacks is not enough.

tasks.name: Mine's Better
steps: Equip an actual shield and pair it with one-handed weapons before starting level one.
Keep the shield worn through every boss, grub and special-attack switch; two-handed weapons would remove it.
Defeat levels one through eight without ever taking the shield off.

tasks.name: Doom Crawler
steps: Boost before engaging level-one Doom and prepare your opening damage sequence.
Handle the first hazards without dropping unnecessary attacks, then finish in under 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Doom Chaser
steps: Prepare supplies and an efficient route through levels one to eight before starting.
Kill grubs promptly and handle charge and acid mechanics without extended pauses in damage.
Finish the complete eight-level sequence in under 10:00; eight individually fast kills can still lose time between levels.

tasks.name: Doom Racer
steps: Use a practised eight-level setup with boosts and special attacks planned around safe damage windows.
Keep grub handling and movement efficient, and minimise delays between delves.
Complete levels one through eight in under 7:15 using the full sequence timer.

tasks.name: Mopping up
steps: Let at least eight acid splats accumulate along a route you can clear during one Volatile Earth attack.
Use the Volatile Earth objects to create the earthen shield and choose its path through those splats.
Clear all eight in that one attack; smaller clears across multiple attacks are not added together.

tasks.name: Shellbane Adept
steps: Bring a tortugan shield, melee supplies and protection prayers to the Shellbane cave.
Move away from spit and whirlwind targets while keeping your defensive setup equipped; work towards 25 total kills.

tasks.name: Shellbane Veteran
steps: Use a sustainable melee setup with your tortugan shield and supplies for the cave.
React to spit, whirlwinds and knockback rather than staying on one tile throughout; accumulate 50 total Shellbane kills.

tasks.name: Perfect Shellbane
steps: Wear a tortugan shield and enough worn weight to handle the knockback counter, then keep melee protection active.
Move clear of corrosive spit and whirlwinds; react promptly when the boss offers the counter opportunity.
Finish without taking any damage, including ordinary hits caused by losing the shield or prayer.

tasks.name: Shellbane Speedrunner
steps: Prepare all boosts and supplies before entering the cave; the timer includes time spent there between kills.
Keep reactions to spit, whirlwinds and knockback quick so you can resume attacking safely.
Complete ten kills within 12:30 of entering; banking or delaying the first fight wastes that shared window.

tasks.name: Shellbane Survivor
steps: Pack food and prayer supplies for 25 kills before entering the cave.
Keep the tortugan shield equipped and avoid spit and whirlwind targets to conserve supplies.
Stay inside until the twenty-fifth kill; leaving early breaks this stamina attempt.

tasks.name: Dry Cleaning
steps: Leave inventory space to unequip every item, and let corrosive spit actually coat your armour.
Unequip all gear, taking the tortugan shield off last; wait for the message that your armour stops corroding.
Re-equip the shield first, then the rest, and finish the kill; merely dodging the spit is insufficient.

tasks.name: Featherweight Fighter
steps: Check that your worn gear weighs less than 40 kg before entering and keep every switch under that limit.
Bring extra healing for the lighter setup; dodge spit and whirlwinds instead of adding heavy gear to counter knockback.
Complete five kills without leaving the cave while keeping the worn-weight restriction met.

tasks.name: Brutus Novice
steps: Prepare a weapon and a simple damage setup before fighting Brutus.
Engage and keep attacking while managing your health; complete one kill.

tasks.name: Brutus Champion
steps: Use a repeatable weapon setup and carry enough healing for several attempts.
Kill Brutus until your total reaches ten; you can replenish supplies between kills.

tasks.name: Brutus Speed-Trialist
steps: Boost and prepare your strongest immediate hit or special attack before engaging Brutus.
Deliver the finishing damage in under two seconds; slow setup after the first attack consumes the entire window.

tasks.name: Beef vs Beef
steps: Unequip every item before fighting Brutus and leave food and potions unused.
Fight unarmed, keeping equipment slots empty throughout the attempt.
Finish without equipping or consuming anything; even a temporary weapon switch breaks the task.

tasks.name: Smarter than a Cow
steps: Prepare a burst finish or use distance to keep Brutus from reaching an attack opportunity.
Kill him before he attacks you; keep moving if needed without accidentally letting him into range.
An attack blocked to zero still fails this task, so do not rely on protection prayers as the solution.

tasks.name: Maggot Squasher
steps: Enter with an attacking setup and supplies ready; keep your movement controlled through the arena.
Respond to the boss's special attacks before resuming damage and finish one Maggot King kill.

tasks.name: Maggot Exterminator
steps: Use a reliable damage setup and conserve supplies by handling arena hazards promptly.
Complete 25 Maggot King kills in total; replenish supplies when needed because this is not a single-trip target.

tasks.name: Camping the King
steps: Bring enough supplies for twelve kills before entering the arena.
Use controlled movement and deal with each dangerous mechanic before returning to boss damage.
Stay in the arena until the twelfth kill; leaving to bank breaks the streak.

tasks.name: Maggot King Speed Chaser
steps: Prepare boosts and supplies before entering the arena; the nine-minute timer starts on entry.
Keep the first five fights efficient and avoid long pauses for looting or preparation between them.
Complete all five kills within nine minutes without relying on five separate combat-only timers.

tasks.name: Trying to fit in
steps: Bring qualifying Vampyrium weapons, such as a rune halberd or dragon battleaxe, and keep outside-region weapons out of your switches.
Manually cast fire spells without equipping a staff if using magic; switch to a permitted melee weapon for punish windows.
Handle larvae and finish the Maggot King using only qualifying weapons, including any damaging special attacks.

tasks.name: King-sized clobbering
steps: Keep a melee weapon ready even if you use another style for ordinary damage.
React to every melee-punish window and land the required melee attack before the opportunity ends.
Finish without missing a single punish; focusing only on the last window does not satisfy the task.

tasks.name: Digging in
steps: Plan a compact route before engaging and favour a position that needs only short dodges.
Count movement in tiles rather than clicks; long paths and automatic approaches can consume the allowance quickly.
Finish with no more than 40 tiles of movement across the whole fight.

tasks.name: Cordoned Off
steps: Start on the back row and use a weapon that can attack from there without pulling you forward.
Handle movement by staying along that row; avoid attack clicks that automatically step closer to the boss.
Finish without moving beyond the back row at any point.

tasks.name: Perfect Maggot King
steps: Dodge every avoidable attack and interrupt the boss's healing opportunities before returning to damage.
Prevent larvae reaching their healing opportunity and keep your route clear of arena hazards.
Finish with no avoidable damage and no boss healing anywhere in the fight.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Adept
steps: Bring a reliable attack setup and enough supplies to practise the Mad Angel's special attacks.
Respond to sweep, smite and blast mechanics, then resume damage safely; accumulate 25 total kills.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Veteran
steps: Use a setup you can sustain and practise the enhanced attack openings after special mechanics.
Keep each kill controlled through enrage and build to 50 total kills; they need not be in one arena visit.

tasks.name: Perfect Mad Angel
steps: Watch each sweep, smite and blast cue and resolve it before taking another ordinary attack.
Keep the correct protection active for smites, dodge sweeps and handle blast rebounds safely.
Finish with no avoidable damage; healing through a special does not preserve the attempt.

tasks.name: This Is Madness
steps: Bring supplies for fifteen kills before entering the Mad Angel arena.
Handle her special attacks deliberately to conserve health and prayer through repeated enrage phases.
Stay until fifteen kills are complete; leaving the arena to replenish supplies breaks the streak.

tasks.name: Mad Angel Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare boosts and supplies before entering; the ten-minute clock starts at the arena entrance.
Use safe enhanced attack openings and keep pauses between the first five kills short.
Finish five kills within ten minutes of entry; a fast final kill alone is insufficient.

tasks.name: Dancing Queen
steps: Leave the Mad Angel alive long enough to enter enrage; use a weapon quick enough to take consecutive openings.
Dodge each sweep from the safe side, then immediately use its enhanced attack opportunity.
Land six consecutive sweep-enhanced attacks during enrage; avoid an ordinary hit breaking the sequence.

tasks.name: Smite Fight
steps: Keep the Mad Angel alive into enrage and prepare a quick attack sequence for the smites.
Use the correct protection prayer on each smite and attack in the resulting enhanced windows.
Land three consecutive smite-enhanced attacks during enrage; unenhanced attacks do not count towards the three.

tasks.name: Juggling Act
steps: Reach the enrage phase with the Mad Angel still alive and your attack ready.
Position for each blast bounce, then land an attack before the next bounce.
Keep alternating bounce and attack through the sequence; bouncing everything first and attacking afterwards fails the condition.

tasks.name: The Pen Is Mightier
steps: Leave the weapon slot empty before engaging. Bring runes for manually cast spells and, if available, thralls; off-hand equipment can stay equipped.
Cast directly from the spellbook without equipping a staff, and use the boss mechanics' empowered unarmed attacks when appropriate.
Finish with the weapon slot empty throughout; do not equip a staff or special-attack weapon even briefly.
